_comment: WebUI TTS 高级参数控件配置：按模型 family 动态生成控件（gr.render）。每项字段：name=选项键(随请求 options 透传给模型)；type=slider|number|bool|text|choice；label/info=显示文案；default=默认值(应等于模型默认，已按 src/models/<family>/*.cpp 校对)；minimum/maximum/step=数值范围；precision=0 表示整数；choices=下拉候选。规则：只有被用户改动过的控件值才会随请求发送；seed/max_tokens 已有专用输入框，勿在此重复；参考文本用『参考文本』框(reference_text)；文件路径/parity 类参数(如 *_noise_file)未纳入，可用『其它参数(JSON)』兜底框传。

minimax_music3.info_en: Decode N independent takes in one batched pass (seeds seed, seed+1, ...). Extra takes are returned as take_01...take_NN.

minimax_music3.label: flow_uncond_interval

minimax_music3.name: flow_uncond_warmup
minimax_music3.label: flow_uncond_warmup
minimax_music3.info_en: Leading steps that always evaluate the unconditional branch when reuse is on.

minimax_music3.name: flow_chunk_hop_frames
minimax_music3.label: flow_chunk_hop_frames
minimax_music3.info_en: 0 uses the model config's hop of 100. A larger hop means fewer chunks and less double-denoising.

minimax_h3.name: num_inference_steps
